text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the park on our way back from an outing with Fenomeno—

text_block_list.name: Nursery Teacher
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *gasp*, *pant*, *pant*...
I-I can't go on...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Irregular breathing and poor complexion. A textbook case of exhaustion.
What happened to you!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Teacherrr, hurry up and chase me~.
Over here, Mr. Tag-man!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little Umamusume were running around a woman sitting on the ground.
It seemed the nursery teacher was completely worn out from playing with them.
choice_data_list: You've been taking care of everything all by yourself... That must be tough.

text_block_list.name: Nursery Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Today just so happens to be a day...
where none of the Umamusume staff are in...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I understand the situation.
I will look after the children here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: First, we shall gather the children, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... EV-ERY-ONE! FALL! INNN!!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaa!? What is it, what is it!?
No way~~~~! It's so scaryyyy~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, shoot...!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaahn! Nooo~!
Help me Mommy~! Waaaahn!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, we're friends of the teacher.
It's okay, we're friends of the teacher!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
A friend... Ugh, but it's scary...
An ogre... It looks like a real ogre...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Guh... I scared them again.
How pathetic of me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wants to play together and entertain the kids,
but they are utterly terrified of Fenomeno.
choice_data_list: (She was saying something about being "like a demon"... Hm?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An idea suddenly comes to mind.
If Fenomeno agrees to it,
we might be able to use how intimidated everyone is to our advantage.
choice_data_list: Only if you don't mind, but...
Only if you don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, do you have an idea?!
As expected of the boss!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Play tag while playing the ogre.
That way, by playing together, she might get used to it
and stop being afraid of her.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the children will surely be delighted.
Please let me do it, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: High-intensity game of tag, start-desu!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! You won't get away!
Who wants to be apprehended next, sir?~~!!
choice_data_list: Meno, try to act a little more demon-like...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah... *ahem*!
Prepare to be devoured, yes, sir-ree!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: St-Stay awaaaay!!"
choice_data_list: That's it, Meno, keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-You'll never catch me~~!
Bleeehh!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahahaha!
I won't let you escape, sir~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Target secured, ha-haaa!
Aaaah-ha-ha-ha-ha!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now, what should we do with them?
Shall we hear their side of the story first?
choice_data_list: Oh no! Let's work together and help them!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Y-Yeah! I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: L-L-Let go of her...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: N-No one told me about an all-out charge, sir!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: N-No tickling attacks! Ahihihihihi!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I looooose~~!

text_block_list.name: Nursery Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for helping out with the kids!
It looks like they all had a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't worry about it.
Helping those in need is only natural!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It! You won't catch me next time!
Bleeeeh!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I'm ready to take you on anytime, sir!
Gwahahaha!
choice_data_list: I'm really glad everyone was happy with it!
I'm so glad everyone was happy!
This is the duty of an ally of justice too.
This is the duty of an ally of justice too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I'm ready to take you on anytime, sir!
Gwahahaha!
choice_data_list: I'm really glad everyone was happy with it!
I'm so glad everyone was happy!
This is the duty of an ally of justice too.
This is the duty of an ally of justice too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: All of this is thanks to you, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: To think that even I could bring joy to children... Hehe, I might have gotten the hang of it a little.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to next time.
We shall play with all our might again, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes. Knowing we protected the children's smiles brings me great relief.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I hope you all continue to play, learn, and grow up healthy and strong.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It was an honor
to be of assistance!
